title: Roulette betting
summary: Up to three players can now bet real chips on the roulette wheel, one spin every 30 seconds.
notes: Let up to three players take a seat at the roulette table: the first to sit opens a 30-second betting round, and seated players watch from their seat, looking around but unable to walk off until the spin ends or they cancel their bets and leave.

Press C (controller Y) at the table to open an overhead betting view with a chip rack from $1 to $25K: place any mix of chips on straight, split, street, corner, top-line, six-line, column, dozen and even-money bets, up to your wallet balance, with each spot's win probability and odds shown.

Spin the wheel when betting closes with the camera panning over it, sweep losing chips, mark the winning number and settle every player's bets at American odds (n/38 to win, paying 36/n - 1 to 1, with the top line at 6 to 1) in one atomic wallet operation.
Dress the roulette screens as Golden Crown table furniture: mahogany and felt panels, a velvet title plaque, cream-and-brass buttons, round chips and a brass pointer over the selected chip.
Add a dealer standing behind the roulette table, and remove the potted palm crowding its wheel end.
